_about: Labeled rule pairs for `jdad kb dupes` (roadmap P2.2, JON-1362). Written before any scores were computed. duplicate = the same rule with only case, spacing or punctuation changed; paraphrase = the same instruction reworded; distinct = a nearby rule that says something different. kb_distinct names pairs of real rule IDs in practices/ that are different rules.
